notes.title: BETA Redesign and Rebalance
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=S_rZtpyR3FY;full][/previewyoutube]
OVERHAULING THE STYLISH POINTS SYSTEM

Additions and Fixes

* Recent actions now appear directly under your style score for easy visibility.
* Up to 5 most recent actions are displayed at once.
* Repeated actions are now combined into a single entry with a counter.
* New effect when points are added to your score.
* Score now pulsates briefly when it changes for extra emphasis.

REBALANCING


Significantly increased the score requirements for top ranks:
* SSS Rank: 100,000+ points (previously 50,000+)
* SS Rank: 50,000+ points (previously 20,000+)
* S Rank: 25,000+ points (previously 10,000+)
* A Rank: 10,000+ points (previously 5,000+)
* B Rank: 5,000+ points (unchanged)
* C Rank: 2,000+ points (unchanged)

* Chain your moves together to build up a combo multiplier.
* Each successive action within 5 seconds increases your combo count.
* Combo multiplier starts at 1.1x and increases by 0.1x for each action in the combo.
* your combo resets if you wait too long between actions!

DONT LET YOUR SCORE GET STALE

* Performing unique actions now grants a 1.5x point bonus.
* The system tracks your last 5 unique actions, mix it up.
* Your stylish score now decays twice as fast – every 0.5 seconds instead of 1 second.
* The decay amount is now 1% of your current score or 100 points, whichever is higher.
* To prevent losses of score due to song downtime, the score check now only happens during beats

MULTIPLIERS

* The maximum multiplier has been increased to 10x (previously 8x).
